description: Call any view/pure function with a human-readable signature on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon or BSC: decoded result, raw hex, block number, chain id; 422 with revert reason on revert. Price: $0.003 USDC per call, paid with x402 on Base.

args.description: Arguments in order; integers may be strings

blockTag.description: latest (default), safe, finalized, earliest, pending or a block number (alias: block)

chain.description: ethereum (default), base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc or chain id

function.description: Human-readable signature, e.g. "balanceOf(address) view returns (uint256)"; the "function " prefix is optional; include returns (...) to decode

name: chainread_read_contract
